    if not res:
        break
    contacts.extend(res)
    if len(res) < 20:

# Fetch movie recommendations note
note = apis.simple_note.show_note(access_token=simple_note_token, note_id=1556)
content = note['content']

# Extract movie titles that are associated with director Quentin Tarantino
# Format in note: Title line then subsequent '- director: ...'
lines = [ln.strip() for ln in content.splitlines() if ln.strip()]

matches=[]
current_title=None
current_director=None
# Approach: iterate lines; when a line does not start with '-' and is not header, treat as title.
# When line starts with '- director:' capture.
for ln in lines:
    if ln.startswith('#'):
        continue
    if ln.startswith('-'):
        # director line
        if ln.lower().startswith('- director:'):
            current_director = ln.split(':',1)[1].strip()
        continue
    else:
        # title line
        current_title = ln
        current_director = None
        continue
    # After a director line appears, record if matches; need also know title. But loop above continues.

# Better: single pass where we detect title, then look for director line in subsequent lines.
matches=[]
for i, ln in enumerate(lines):
    if ln.startswith('#'):
        continue
    if ln.startswith('-'):
        continue
    # ln is title. Check next few lines for director
    title = ln
    director=None
    # search forward until blank or next title; in our cleaned lines, next title is non-dash and not header.
    for j in range(i+1, min(i+6, len(lines))):
        ln2=lines[j]
        if ln2.startswith('#'):
            continue
        if ln2.startswith('-'):
            if ln2.lower().startswith('- director:'):
                director = ln2.split(':',1)[1].strip()
                break
        else:
            # reached next title
            break
    if director and director.lower().startswith('quentin tarantino'):
        matches.append(title)

# Deduplicate while preserving order
seen=set()
ordered=[]
for t in matches:
    if t not in seen:
        ordered.append(t)
        seen.add(t)

print('Extracted Tarantino-directed titles from Simple Note note_id=1556:')
for t in ordered:

message_text = ', '.join(ordered)
